notes.content:
Hi all, 

-Improved balance to penguin mini-game (reduced move speed and max spawn rate of bats). There was a lot of feedback on the tuning of the difficulty and I hope this tips things in the right direction - please keep the feedback coming if the balance can still be improved!
If you are still struggling with any minigames, a "godmode" can be activated pressing the G key. 

-Added a sensitivity slider option if you are using a controller (if you use a controller, stay tuned because my current major task is slowly building up better controller support)

-many minor bug fixes

Thanks so much for playing, for your support, and for continued feedback since launch - I think the game is already in a much better place in just under 3 weeks!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hi all, thanks for everyone who has been enjoying the game and providing feedback and bug reports so far! Here are the updates for this patch:

Recipe discovery system!
From now on, after you unlock the alchemy station, there is a small chance that a recipe page will drop when harvesting certain crops or Critters. Discovered recipes will be recorded in the stats tab (the blue star) in the journal.

Mute buttons for poop and text sounds – Important: If you are a current player, these will be turned on when you start your game after the update. They will save with your other settings accordingly, afterwards.

Ability to skip cutscenes

Many many many bugfixes (thanks for the patience and assistance in squashing this so far!)

notes.title: CritterGarden out now!
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone![/p][p][/p][p]CritterGarden 1.0 is officially out! Thank you to everyone who has followed and supported the three year journey up until now, especially those who have playtested and contributed feedback to the game's development. If you're a new player, welcome and thanks for checking the game out! I truly hope you are able to appreciate what I tried to capture by making this game, and that you enjoy playing it as much as I enjoyed making it![/p][p][/p][p]Here's a roadmap for the game going forward:[/p][p][/p][p]1.) Bug fixes, balancing/tweaks, QoL[/p][p]The absolute initial priority, I plan to make sure the current base game is as bug free and fun to play as possible! Please drop by the discord if you encounter any issues or have minor QoL suggestions.[/p][p][/p][p]2.) Better controller support, console porting, localization[/p][p]The next step will be to port the game to other platforms, with a particular focus on a potential mobile release, and Switch 2. This of course will require a better controller interface. If the demand is there, I am also open to pursue localization via translation.[/p][p][/p][p]3.) Additional content[/p][p]There are no concrete plans for additional content, but the longer term stretch goal would be to pursue additional (and fully free) content updates. This could include something like new Critters, plants, objects, or perhaps even separate mini-planets with fresh Critter phylogenies.[/p][p]
Have a great day & weekend, [/p][p]
David[/p]

notes.title: CritterGarden Releasing June 20th!
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone! [/p][p]I am super excited to announce that CritterGarden will be releasing on Friday June 20! The full game will feature 96 Critters to discover, 64 plants to grow, and 32 unique objects to help you grow your planet back to life!
[/p][p]I officially started working on CritterGarden in June 2022, so it has been a three year project coming to a close! I'm excited for everyone to experience the full version - for VP fans, I really hope it scratches that itch, and for players new to the genre I hope you discover the joy of creating gardens for your Critters![/p][p]
I will announce more details on the short-term roadmap upon release, but I also really look forward to the reaction and experience of players once the full game is out there. Please join us in the Discord if you have comments or questions![/p][p]Best,[/p][p]David[/p]

notes.title: Next Fest halfway point - The big poop update!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 
Thanks so much for your support and feedback during Next Fest so far!
I'm happy to announce a tiny, but potentially high impact midway update based on the most common feedback I've received so far.
Poop can now be collected simply by hovering your cursor over it - no clicks required! Furthermore, you will collect it no matter what tool you have out - it doesn't have to be the hand (I hear our virtual avatar thanks us dearly for this).

In addition, I doubled the amount of hard soil around the ship when a new game starts. This effectively doubles the amount of fertilizer you can get at the beginning, as some players expressed they were getting bottle-necked and having to wait for the Critters to do their business early on - I hope this helps that out a bit! (but remember to use this valuable resource wisely, as well as use logs to your advantage ;))

Finally, since Next Fest started, 307 players have tried out the demo, and the median play time increased from 29 to 33 minutes! Amazing! Thanks so much for playing and please keep the feedback coming so I can make this the best game I possibly can!

Have a great rest of your week :)

notes.title: CritterGarden in Wholesome Games Celebration and Demo Update
notes.content:
Hi all!
I'm happy to announce CritterGarden will be featured in the Wholesome Games Steam celebration.
Huge thank you to the team over at https://wholesomegames.com/ for hosting this event and for giving indies a shot at some exposure!

To go with the event, I will be launching an updated demo on Aug 15, The most notable feature is the inclusion of Critter variants! Along with the breeding and mutation tabs, you can now click on the variant tab under a Critter's info to learn about what it needs to eat to turn into a variant form! Discovering variant form provides experience, which I think really helps streamline and speed-up the "slower" early game progression.

Enjoy the winding down days of summer, I will be back in the Fall with more updates, along with news about NextFest participation!
